text:
maya chen: Quick flag — PR #9182 (kv-cache leak fix) needs 2x LGTM before the 30m cutover. Root cause: missing nil guard in invalidate path.
lee wong: I can take a look. CI shows `integration/storage` failing. Could be test flakiness.
ci-bot: build/9182 • integration/storage failed on node-2 • logs: https://ci.redwood/9182/logs
ryan patel: I'm on PTO but available for a quick +1 if tests pass smoke and perf. Won't run full load.
tara ops: Ops prefers canary deploy. If canary fails, what's the quick revert? :question:
maya chen: Rollback: revert the merge, redeploy previous image tag, run recovery job `kv-cache-regress`. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/kv-cache-recovery
lee wong: Found flaky assertion in test harness; pushing a tiny test-only fix to the PR. Rerunning CI.
lee wong: Ran locally: `make test-integration TEST=storage` — hit `timeout waiting for compaction` once, fixed harness timing.
ci-bot: build/9182 • rerun queued
maya chen: Can runtime owners prioritize a review? This touches cache invalidation and hot paths.
ryan patel: Reviewed diff — looks safe. Added note about micro-ops on eviction frequency; will run `./scripts/local-kv-smoke.sh` and paste results.
ryan patel: Local smoke OK. I'm +1 for correctness but want one more runtime owner for perf risk.
lee wong: Measured quick perf: p50 +1.4ms, p95 unchanged. +1 from me :thumbsup:
tara ops: Read the canary steps, monitoring boards set, alert thresholds configured. +1 from ops for rollout.
maya chen: OK 2 approvals (lee + tara). CI green on rerun. Plan: merge during the quiet window (T+5m), canary for 10m, then promote.
ops-bot: Canary job started: canary/9182 on prod-canary-4 • will alert #incidents if unhealthy
maya chen: Merging now, will watch logs and dashboards.
ci-bot: merge/9182 • merged by maya chen • sha: d4e5f6a
ops-bot: Canary healthy after 10m, promoting to stable in 3m :eyes:
maya chen: Promotion complete. Thread resolved — reach out if any regressions and we'll incident-tag. Thanks all :rocket:
